title: Pan-Seared Haddock with Irish Toast
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring pan-seared haddock served with toasted Irish bread.
instructions: Season the haddock fillets with salt.
Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the haddock for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the Irish bread slices.
Mix the minced garlic with the toasted bread slices.
Serve the pan-seared haddock with the garlic toast and a squeeze of lemon juice.
